failing_tests: unit (windows-latest, 3.11): the hosted runner was lost while the unittest step was in progress; no test summary, no log
entries.classification_evidence: GitHub check-run annotation on job 109003484225: 'The hosted runner lost communication with the server. Anything in your workflow that terminates the runner process, starves it for CPU/Memory, or blocks its network access can cause this error.' The unittest step was still in_progress when the job ended at 16:21:25Z after 47 minutes (started 15:34:24Z); no log was uploaded (logs endpoint 404 BlobNotFound); the four Linux jobs passed (4779 run) and the local suite passed (4782 run). Candidate contributing cause under measurement: the new matrix test spawns subprocesses from four parallel workers for several minutes on the Windows runner; attempt 2 (a retry of this job on the same commit) measures whether the loss recurs.

entries.package: WP-2.0.3 implementation commit; retry of the lost Windows job (diagnostic: no approved CI retry count)
entries.classification_evidence: The retry ran the whole suite (Ran 4776 tests in 2982 s; the runner loss of attempt 1 did not recur; the reference-and-mutant matrix passed on Windows). One failure: the fixture's REQUIREMENTS.md must be byte-identical to the frozen document (sha256 3a6a9995…), and the Windows autocrlf checkout rewrote it with CRLF; a fixture packaging defect in the harness, not a product or reference defect. Corrected in the next commit by pinning the fixture directory to LF in .gitattributes (the repository's rule for byte-exact fixtures).
